name: Tennessee

fees.note: Excessive width: $20 up to 14', $30 to 16', then $30 + $5 per foot or fraction over 16' (tiers listed to 26'; add $5/ft beyond).

Excessive length fee. Legal is the towed unit (50' from the kingpin, i.e. a 53' trailer), not the overall length; modeled as overall length over 73' (20' tractor + 53' trailer). Overhang over 5' front+rear total also needs a permit per TDOT FAQ.
$0.06 per ton-mile on weight over 80,000 lb (TDOT FAQ). The $0.12/ton-mile rate over 165,000 lb in the rule applies to towing vehicles only.
TDOT Structures bridge evaluation, charged per route proposed: $100 (165,001-250,000 lb), $300 (250,001-500,000 lb), actual cost over 500,000 lb (not priced here).

escorts.when: Over 12'6" wide, on interstates and freeways
Over 12'6" wide, on two-lane and other roads

police.text: 2 police escorts. THP escort for loads 18' wide on Interstate or federal-aid highways (FAQ: at least 2-3 troopers; TDOT price list: $65/hour + $0.13/mile per trooper; Level 2 inspection, 10+ days processing). Also possible for any super load at TDOT's discretion.
2 police escorts. THP escort for loads 18' high on any highway (FAQ: at least 2-3 troopers; $65/hour + $0.13/mile per trooper).

restrictions.text: Over 12'6" wide, 15' high or 90' long: no Interstate movement 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM Mon-Fri in counties over 250,000 population. Otherwise 24/7 movement is allowed.
Over 15' high: no Interstate movement 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM Mon-Fri in counties over 250,000 population.
Over 90' long: no Interstate movement 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM Mon-Fri in counties over 250,000 population.

Holidays (2026 TDOT notice): no ESCORTED travel from 6 PM Thursday before Good Friday through Easter Sunday; from noon Friday through Memorial Day and Labor Day; from noon July 2 through July 4; from noon the Wednesday before Thanksgiving through the following Sunday; Dec 24-25 and Dec 31-Jan 1 (the rule itself, 1680-07-01-.04(2)(f), reserves December 24 through January 1). Loads not needing escorts may travel continuously under the 2026 notice.
Super heavy/extra-overdimensional loads (over 165,000 lb, 16' wide or 15'6" high) may get time-of-movement limits set by TDOT; movement may also be restricted in bad weather.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

sources.title: Rules of TDOT Chapter 1680-07-01 Overweight and Overdimensional Movements (rev. May 2018)

notes: Single trip permit valid 10 calendar days, no extensions. Over-dimension-only applications take 3-5 days; any weight 7-10 business days; THP-escorted loads at least 10 days.
Over 10' up to 12'6" wide: front escort required only on roads with pavement narrower than 24' (not modeled); flagperson at bridges with roadway under 20'.
Over 16' wide requires a letter of necessity/shipper's letter; super loads need a detailed traffic control proposal and Structures Division approval.
Holiday escort ban also applies to escorted loads triggered by height (>15') and length (>90'); only the width trigger is attached to the restriction line above.
Bridge evaluation for loads over 500,000 lb is billed at actual cost; Structures approval may also be required under 165,000 lb depending on axle spacing.
